rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is nearly or almost at a stated degree or condition.

example.jyutping: caa1 m4 do1 sap6 dim2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when nearly means that an event or change is about to happen soon.

example.english: It's nearly time to finish work.

rows.note: Use this when something almost happened, especially when the outcome was narrowly avoided.

example.english: I nearly got hit by a car.
example.jyutping: ngo5 caa1 di1 bei2 gaa3 ce1 zong6 dou2
